d: Job Category Food and Beverage & Culinary
Location Sheikh Khalifa Bin Salman Highway, Al Seef District, Manama, BahrainVIEW ON MAP

Greet guests and determine the number in their party. Seat guests by finding a clean, available table; pulling out chairs; placing clean/current menu in front of guest, etc. Guide guests through the dining rooms and provide any needed assistance. Move and arrange tables, chairs, and settings and organize seating for groups with special needs. Ensure place settings are appropriate and each guest has a napkin, clean silverware, and any other item that is part of the standard place setting. Check menus to ensure they are current, clean, plentiful, and wrinkle-free. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures. Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests.

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.

d: Execute and coordinate Business Unit promotional campaigns in accordance with the approved promotion strategy, ensuring accurate campaign preparation, effective communication, and timely implementation across relevant channels. Utilize promotional analysis, market insights, and cross-functional coordination to monitor campaign effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and support the achievement of Business Unit sales objectives and customer engagement targets.
q: Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or any related field.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Promotions, Marketing, Trade Marketing, or Commercial Operations.
Experience in planning, coordinating, and executing promotional campaigns.
Experience in promotional communication materials, POSM, and campaign implementation.
r: Prepare and coordinate promotional campaign plans based on the approved promotional calendar and Business Unit requirements.
Consolidate promotional inputs and requirements from Commercial, Category Management, Marketing, E-commerce, Operations, and Visual Merchandising teams.
Coordinate promotional offers, mechanics, product selections, and campaign details with Category Management to ensure accuracy and readiness.
Prepare campaign briefs, implementation timelines, and communication requirements in line with the approved promotional direction.
Monitor competitor promotional activities and market trends, providing relevant findings and recommendations to the line manager.
Coordinate the operational implementation of promotional campaigns across stores and relevant customer touchpoints.
Follow up on promotional campaign readiness, including pricing, product information, offer mechanics, and availability of required promotional materials.
Coordinate with Category Management to follow up on promotional product selections, offers, and campaign requirements.
Monitor campaign execution across stores in coordination with Store Operations and Visual Merchandising teams, highlighting deviations and supporting corrective actions.
Identify operational challenges affecting promotional activities and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to facilitate timely resolution.
Coordinate the preparation and development of promotional communication materials, including Point of Sale Materials (POSM), promotional magazines, and outdoor communication.
Prepare creative briefs and communicate campaign requirements to graphic designers and external agencies in accordance with approved promotional concepts.
Follow up on the development, revision, and delivery of promotional artwork and communication materials.
Follow up with printing agencies on production schedules, material specifications, and quality requirements.
Coordinate with Visual Merchandising teams to ensure the proper distribution and installation of promotional communication materials across stores.
Review promotional materials to identify content inaccuracies and ensure alignment with approved campaign details before implementation.
Coordinate with Marketing, E-commerce, Category Management, IT, Store Operations, and Visual Merchandising teams to facilitate the implementation of approved promotional campaigns.
Communicate campaign details, promotional mechanics, and implementation requirements to relevant stakeholders to ensure operational readiness.
Coordinate with IT teams regarding system-related promotional requirements, testing, and implementation follow-up.
Provide campaign information and execution guidelines to Store Operations and Visual Merchandising teams to support consistent promotional implementation.
Follow up on the reflection of approved promotional campaigns across relevant physical and digital customer touchpoints.
Participate in cross-functional meetings and follow up on agreed campaign actions and deliverables.
Monitor promotional campaign performance against established KPIs and approved sales objectives.
Collect, consolidate, and analyze promotional sales data to assess campaign performance and identify sales uplift opportunities.
Prepare periodic promotional performance reports, including campaign results, sales trends, and promotional effectiveness indicators.
Conduct promotional payback and performance analysis in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Identify gaps, trends, and improvement opportunities in promotional execution and effectiveness.
Provide analytical findings and recommendations to the line manager and relevant stakeholders to support future promotional planning and optimization.
Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and established promotional guidelines.
Maintain effective professional relationships with internal stakeholders and external service providers to facilitate promotional activities.
Maintain accurate promotional documentation, campaign records, and performance reports.
Perform other related duties as assigned by the direct manager.
Working Hours : 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (1 hour break)
